name: Inured to Toxin
body:
Through exposures to a poisonous substance, you can build a resistance

Prerequisite(s): Saved against previous exposure to the chosen poison.

Benefit(s): You gain immunity to one poison, chosen when you take this feat and gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against poisons of the same type (contact, ingestion, inhalation, or injury).
